messages:
incident-bot: PagerDuty alert fired -> PD#78921: redis-cluster-eu maxclients reached, error rate spike on api-frontend-eu. Auto-page to eng-oncall.
maya_oncall: acked oncall, pulling up dashboards now. seeing ~98% maxclients on redis-primary-eu-1. TTLs spiking, lots of 'OOM or maxclients' in logs.
maya_oncall: quick note — traffic spike from embeddings pipeline (batch job) started ~5m ago, correlates with client: ingestion-worker-prod.
omar_db: on it. can we get pconn counts and the client list? asking for `CLIENT LIST` output to see top offenders. @linh_sre FYI in case we need immediate failover.
maya_oncall: pasting top-level metrics snapshot:
```
redis_primary_eu1.maxclients = 16384 (limit)
redis_primary_eu1.connected_clients = 16290
redis_primary_eu1.instantaneous_ops_per_sec = 52000
redis_primary_eu1.instantaneous_input_kbps = 12000
errors.5xx.rate(api-frontend-eu) = 4.8% (baseline 0.2%)
```
maya_oncall: CLIENT LIST shows many short-lived clients from ingestion-worker-prod pool id=ingest-v2, looks like it opened new connection per request.
omar_db: ok two-pronged mitigation: 1) throttle the ingestion job traffic (ask infra to pause/batch) 2) temporary bump redis maxclients on primary to avoid immediate 5xx and give time for controlled rollback.
priya_prod: paged infra-runbook, tagging ingestion team. sending a request to stop ingestion job now.
linh_sre: if we bump maxclients, need to verify file descriptor limits and monitor across replicas. Also consider enabling client-side pooling fix in the ingestion service (quick patch).
maya_oncall: executed emergency throttle: `kubectl scale job/ingestion-worker-prod --replicas=0` (infra accepted). Observed connected_clients drop to ~15600 within 20s. error rate falling to 2.1%.
omar_db: still high but stabilizing. I'll run a controlled increase on maxclients + ulimit on redis hosts. Doing now:
```
# on redis-primary-eu-1
sudo sysctl -w fs.file-max=200000
sudo systemctl restart redis.service --with-args "--maxclients 20000"
```
omar_db: changes applied, connected_clients now 14800, ops/sec normalizing. Please keep ingestion paused for 10m and let's audit pools.
priya_prod: ingestion team confirmed they had a regression in the client library that removed connection reuse. They're rolling a hotfix and will re-enable at reduced rate.
maya_oncall: quick customer impact note: A subset of EU customers using embeddings and chat experienced elevated latencies (avg token latency +450ms) and intermittent 502/503s for ~8 minutes. We're preparing a short status update.
linh_sre: recommend follow-on actions: 1) postmortem to track root cause (broken connection pooling) 2) add alert for sustained client churn (connections opened/sec) 3) add circuit-breaker in ingestion job to backoff on errors.
omar_db: filing a DB ticket to add connection sampling and to blacklist runaway client prefixes. I'll also add rate-limiting in proxy layer as intermediate.
maya_oncall: handoff plan — I'll remain for a 30m watch. If things look good, I'll escalate back to next oncall at 171? (tomorrow). @omar_db can you take ownership of the postmortem and remediation items?
omar_db: will take postmortem + remediation. tagging in ticket.
priya_prod: PagerDuty note: incident auto-escalation timer canceled (acked). Marking impacted customers list: cust-A (EU), cust-D (EU), cust-internal-qa. No payment-critical tenants affected.
incident-bot: PD#78921 -> acknowledged by maya_oncall at 1708123472, escalation paused.
maya_oncall: quick checklist before close: verify ingestion re-enable at throttled rate, monitor connected_clients < 70% of max, ensure patch merged for client pooling.
priya_prod: ingestion team will re-enable at 20% traffic in 12m and report. I'll update status page when stable.
maya_oncall: 12m update: ingestion re-enabled at 20%, connected_clients steady at ~10500, errors <0.3%. Preparing to resolve slack thread in 15m if stable.
omar_db: remediation tasks created: CORE-4521 (connection pooling fix), CORE-4522 (alerts for conn churn), CORE-4523 (proxy rate limit).
maya_oncall: thanks everyone. final note for PM/customer success: small number of EU customers saw degraded service for ~8m window. We'll include mitigation + ETA for full rollback in the postmortem. closing watch in 15. :white_check_mark:
priya_prod: incident resolved from oncall perspective, will hand to montly postmortem owner.
maya_oncall: closing thread. good job team.
